messages:
nora: Heads-up — Solace onboarding tomorrow. Demo went OK but renewal sentiment slipped (NPS=6). Plan: conservative prefill + transient warm pool; capture 48h micro-pulse.

ben: What are the traffic hotspots?

nora: main pain is /batch/generate during import (~150 r/s for 12m, avg seq 280) and chat bursts up to 60 r/s.

adele: For that profile I recommend: prefix cache TTL=25s for repeated system prompts, KV session cache for chat, batch.window_ms=40, jitter=0.12, max_batch_tokens=1400. Streaming partial responses for chat to hide retries.

sam: Warm pool: warm_workers=5 from -10m to +25m; auto-scale +3 if queue_depth > 60% for 2m. Fallback: if p99>1200ms OR error_rate>3% for 3m -> route to quantized_small + enable partial_streaming and per-client throttles.

ben: Ops, please schedule a light prefill. Need the curl.

nora: paste below (cap pref_rate to avoid origin overload):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/warmup \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RID" \
  -d '{"tenant":"solace","routes":["/batch/generate","/chat"],"prefill_size":300,"prefill_rate":40}'
```

cs-ops-bot: Warmup job queued: id=wm-2027-09-15-solace-01 run_at=3189993600

adele: Observability checklist: emit events prefill.start, prefill.done, cache.hit_ratio, batch.p50/95/99, stream.first_byte_ms, fallback.count. Tag tenant.renewal_signal=watch and survey_context=post-demo-import.

sam: Alerting: 3m short-window alert for p99>1200ms OR error_rate>3% -> trigger routing fallback, notify #cs-oncall, and link runbook. Also add a dashboard widget for prefill.success and cache.hit_rate.

ben: Ownership: @sam will run prefill + monitor, @adele will add metric emits and dashboard, @nora will draft 48h pulse and outreach if needed.

cs-ops-bot: Warmup job completed: id=wm-2027-09-15-solace-01 status=success duration=20s prefilled=298 routes=2

sam: Initial metrics look healthy: cache.hit_rate=80%, batch.p95=320ms, stream.first_byte=110ms, no fallbacks. Leaving warm pool live for +20m.

nora: Thanks team  will post the Confluence runbook snippet and the pulse template (2 Qs + optional comment). If NPS <=6 auto-create ticket and tag priority=renewal. Closing unless issues pop up. :white_check_mark:
